_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE sample of Sentinel (C8) governing two moments in the running case. Not runnable, not real patients. Ties to samples/recall/discovery-example.json (queryG_similarCases, pat-417) and samples/reasoner/diagnosis-example.json (dx-001 candidate→confirmed, evidence trail). Sentinel authorizes/gates/validates and records; it produces no clinical content.

moment1_cohortDiscovery._scenario: Recall asks Sentinel to authorize discoverSimilarCases(pat-001) on cohort scope, reaching pat-417. Sentinel checks consent + scope, applies de-identification, allows, and audits.

accessDecision.reason: active cohort consent + valid cohort ScopeGrant; allowed on de-identified partition with de-identify obligation

deIdentificationApplied.effect: cohort result returned without direct identifiers
deIdentificationApplied._note: Recall's match case-pat-417 is served as a de-identified candidate; see samples/recall/discovery-example.json queryG_similarCases.

moment2_promotion._scenario: Console asks Sentinel to govern promotion of candidate dx-001 to confirmed (after histology). Sentinel checks the confirming principal's role and provenance completeness of the evidence trail, permits, and audits.

provenanceCheck._note: Every assertion in the trail carries a complete ProvenanceRecord (asserted_by/method/confidence/timestamp). An incomplete trail would block.

accessDecision.reason: confirming principal holds authorized role; evidence-trail provenance complete

moment2_promotion._handoff: On permit, Console confirms dx-001 → status=confirmed in Connectome. Sentinel recorded WHO confirmed and that the trail was complete; it did not confirm the diagnosis itself.

invariants.provenanceStackWide: Every asserted Connectome node/edge carries asserted_by/method/confidence/timestamp (see docs/components/connectome/04-domain-model.md); Sentinel validates completeness and re-checks at promotion.
invariants.cohortScope: Cohort retrieval is gated by Sentinel and served only de-identified (see docs/components/recall/08-granularity-and-spaces.md).
invariants.auditImmutable: AuditEvents are append-only and hash-chained (seq/prevHash/hash); Sentinel never mutates the graph.
